_source: DOMINION slice D24, police questioning: plans/claude-api/CLAUDE_API_DRAFT.md §5.3 E (Kice 2026-11-18: always some consequences, scaled by how low the meter went); mockups a8 (police room) + a9 (release on bail) in plans/claude-api/mockups/index.html #k8 #k9.

alibi.label: Alibi
alibi.say: I was home all night. Ask anyone.

deny.label: Deny
deny.say: I don't know what you're talking about.

lawyer.label: Lawyer up
lawyer.say: I'm not saying another word without my lawyer.

bribe.label: Bribe
bribe.say: Maybe this clears it up. (₽{cost} slides across the table)

officers.name: Officer Pike
officers.sheet: Officer Pike: a nervous rookie on his third week. Wants to impress the sergeant, easily talked round, apologises a lot, mixes up his notes.

lines.open: Um. Right. So. You know why you're here, yeah? Something happened in {district}.
lines.good: Oh. Okay, that… actually makes sense. I'll write that down.
lines.bad: Hmm. I don't think the sergeant's going to buy that.
lines.contradict: Wait, wait. That's not what our {evidence} says.
lines.flip: Oh! I forgot to show you this. We have {evidence}.
lines.inconsistent: Hang on, a minute ago you said something different?
lines.bribeYes: I… didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.
lines.bribeNo: Is that… a bribe? I have to write that down too.
lines.lawyer: Oh. Right. Your lawyer. Okay, we're done, I think.
lines.silent: Not talking? That's… fine. I can wait. I think.
lines.free: You can go. Sorry about all this.
lines.bail: Bail's set. Please don't leave town, it makes paperwork.
lines.held: The sergeant says you're staying the night. Sorry.
lines.parting: Officer Pike: “Please don't make me arrest you again. It's a lot of forms.”

officers.name: Officer Jenny
officers.sheet: Officer Jenny: sharp, fair and by the book. Has seen every excuse in Kanto. Polite but never fooled twice; a bribe offends her.

lines.open: Sit down. We picked you up in {district}. Let's hear your side.
lines.good: Noted. That checks out, for now.
lines.bad: That's thin, and you know it.
lines.inconsistent: That isn't what you told me five minutes ago.
lines.repeat: You've said that. Try something new.
lines.bribeNo: A bribe? That goes in my report, word for word.
lines.lawyer: Fine. Your lawyer can talk to the judge.
lines.silent: Silence is an answer too. Not a good one.
lines.free: You're free to go. Don't make me regret it.
lines.bail: Bail's posted. Stay where we can find you.
lines.parting: Officer Jenny: “I'll be watching {district}. Don't give me a reason.”

officers.name: Officer Dalton
officers.sheet: Officer Dalton: a tired, tough detective who has chased crews like yours for twenty years. Dry, patient, lets silences hang, loves catching a lie on camera.

lines.open: Long night in {district}. Yours or mine, we'll see. Start talking.
lines.bad: I've heard better lies from Magikarp.
lines.flip: Here's one you didn't know we had: {evidence}.
lines.inconsistent: Your story just changed. They always do.
lines.repeat: Saying it twice doesn't make it true.
lines.bribeYes: …I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.
lines.bribeNo: Bribing a detective. Add it to the pile.
lines.lawyer: Lawyer. Sure. We'll talk again, you and me.
lines.silent: Take your time. I've got all night.
lines.bail: Bail's paid. Don't leave the region.
lines.parting: Officer Dalton: “Don't leave {district}. We'll be watching that place of yours.”

lines.caughtStealth: Spotted! The police grab the Boss outside {place}. Questioning at the {district} station.
lines.caughtFight: The police take the Boss in. Questioning at the {district} station.
lines.caughtRaid: The raid ends with the Boss in cuffs. Questioning at the station.
lines.pickup: Heat {heat}%: the police pick the Boss up at dawn. Questioning at the {district} station.
lines.busy: The police are questioning you. Answer first.
lines.cell: Day {day} was spent in a cell.
lines.cellHeld: Days {day} and {next} were spent in a cell.
lines.cellMember: {name} spent the night in a cell.
lines.roomBack: The police tape is off the {room}.
lines.informantGone: {name} is gone, and so is the police's ear in the crew.
lines.informantNight: {name} talked to the police again. Heat +{n}.

say.jail: {name} stays in a cell for {n} Days
